قَبْضٌ The act of taking, taking with the hand; [grasping; clutching; seizing;] taking possession of; or receiving. (S, Msb.) ―
-b2- And [hence], Possession; (S, TA;) as also ↓ قَبْضَةٌ : (S, M, Mgh, Msb, TA:) or the latter is a n. un. [signifying an act of taking, or taking with the hand; a grasp; a seizure; &c.]. (TA.) You say, صَارَ الشَّىْءُ فِى قَبْضِكَ, and ↓ قَبْضَتِكَ , The thing became in thy possession. (S, M. *) And هٰذِهِ الدَّارُ فِى قَبْضِى, (TA,) and ↓ قَبْضَتِى , (M, TA,) This house is in my possession; (M, TA;) like as you say, فِى يَدَى. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
